description: This week's flyer offers for item words, an aisle, or deals near a place: give at least one of `query`, `aisle` or `near`. Each row has a comparable unit price (per kg, L or item), dates (`valid` is the first and last day, Toronto time), the nearest store carrying it, and an offerId for get_offer_evidence and show_offers. At most 50 rows a call; use `aisle` and `unit` filters and `fields` to keep answers small.

attributes.description: Every listed attribute must be present, e.g. ["halal"].

fields.description: Return only these fields per row (offerId and priceKind are always kept), to save tokens.

near.description: Where the shopper is: a Canadian postal code ("M6H 2B6"), an FSA ("M6H"), or "lat,lng".

query.description: Item words, e.g. "chicken thighs". Omit to browse an aisle or the deals near a place.

unit.description: Only offers priced per this unit, so prices compare.

name: search_offers
title: Search flyer offers
